label: Microsoft Entra app with a certificate
description: An Entra app registration that authenticates with a certificate instead of a client secret (private_key_jwt). Replace <tenant-id> in the token URL, fill in the application (client) ID and the certificate's thumbprint, and store the certificate's private key as an unencrypted PKCS#8 PEM in the vault. Add https://login.microsoftonline.com to the credential endpoint allowlist.
